about_the_game:
Step into a world 10 years after the zombie outbreak, where cities have been reclaimed by nature, vines crawl over buildings, and the remnants of humanity cling to survival. In Never Be Alone, every choice matters — from scavenging for resources to navigating hazardous radioactive zones. Will you survive the undead, hostile humans, and the environment itself?

Team Up With Friends:

Why face the apocalypse alone? Team up with friends in seamless COOP for as many players as your PC can handle. Share supplies, coordinate attacks, and build fortified safe havens together. Whether you’re a duo covering each other’s backs or a full squad carving out territory, teamwork can make the difference between life and death.

Immersive Gameplay

  • First & Third-Person Views: Switch perspectives at any time for full immersion or tactical awareness.

  • Advanced Movement: Over 500 animations make your character feel alive and grounded.

  • Weather & Seasons: Snow, rain, fog and thunder affect visibility, movement, and strategy. Track footprints of zombies, animals, and players to anticipate danger.

  • Dynamic Zombies: Face diverse undead, from quick Sprinters and four-legged Ferals to toxic Stalkers and massive Brutes.

Survival Systems:

  • Resource Gathering & Crafting: Hunt, scavenge, and craft to survive. Build defenses, repair weapons, and maintain power with generators and solar panels that reacts to weather, time of day and clouds.

  • Factions & Human Threats: Encounter Military, Bandits, and Scavengers — each with unique behavior, tactics, and danger levels.

  • Weapon Customization: Upgrade weapons with silencers, scopes, flashlights, and extended magazines.

  • Interactive Looting: Shelves empty when items are gone, and loot is visually placed when available with lootables having animations for opening them — making scavenging feel alive.

  • Farming & Food Management: Grow your own crops to sustain yourself and your group and harvests to ensure survival.

Vehicles & Exploration

  • Drivable Vehicles: Six types of vehicles, each with multiple protection variants, let you explore the world efficiently.

  • Travel together: Travel with a friend while carrying supplies and maintaining a mobile way to get around.

  • Environment: Navigate a world overrun by nature, with hidden secrets waiting to be discovered.

Character Customization

Personalize your survivor with different characters, hairstyles, and beards to reflect your style in a post-apocalyptic world.

Do you have what it takes to survive a world reclaimed by nature, teeming with danger at every turn? Gather your friends, sharpen your wits, and remember: you will never be alone.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: I7 10300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660ti
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
